Anna (Product): Thanks everyone — great turnout for today's hybrid all-hands. Posting recording + condensed action grid here. Quick recap: product roadmap highlights, Dedicated capacity SLA update, Private deployment checklist, and hiring + org health.

Raj (CEO): Love the momentum — huge thanks to the teams shipping the Dedicated improvements :tada:

Priya (Eng PM): Question — what's the rollout window for the new autoscale policy? I heard 'next month' but need exact dates for test runs.

Mike S.: Confirming: can we get the latency SLI targets in writing? Ops asked for 95th/99th numbers for benchmarks.

Anna (Product): Short answers: rollout kickoff is 2024-11-06 with a 2-week canary; final cutover 2024-11-20. I'll DM the exact cadence. Latency SLIs: 95th = 120ms, 99th = 200ms. I'm adding both to the doc.

Dana (People Ops): A couple of headcount notes — hiring freeze lifted for infra orgs; expect reqs to go to hiring committee by next week.

Emily (Eng): Added a short post with the quantization improvements and perf graphs to the eng docs. Pinged eng-runtime channel for review.

OpsBot: Recording uploaded — https://redwood-recordings.s3.amazonaws.com/allhands/3421012345.mp4  :white_check_mark:

Anna (Product): Action grid (owners + dates). Please ack below once you've taken ownership.

```
Action items:
- Canaries + monitoring dashboard (owner: Priya) — ack by 2024-10-30
- Publish latency SLI page (owner: Mike S.) — done by 2024-10-27
- Private deployment checklist publish (owner: Emily) — 2024-11-01
- Headcount reqs to hiring committee (owner: Dana) — 2024-10-28
- Customer comms draft for Dedicated SLA changes (owner: Anna) — 2024-10-29
```

Priya (Eng PM): Acked — I'll set up the canary pipeline and invite ops. 

Mike S.: Acked — will post SLI doc today.

Dana (People Ops): Acked.

Emily (Eng): Acked and started the checklist PR.

Anna (Product): TL;DR takeaways: 1) Dedicated SLA + rollout timeline confirmed. 2) Monitoring + SLI are priority next week. 3) Hiring opens for infra. Recording + detailed notes link below.

Notes + recording: https://redwood-notes.internal/allhands/3421012345 (includes slides, Q&A digest, and action tracker)

Raj (CEO): One ask — please attach a short executive one-pager to that notes link for sales/customer teams.

Anna (Product): Will do. Thanks everyone — if you can't take ownership of assigned items, reply here before EOD today so we can reassign.
